security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI M-mode trap handlers or SBI call handlers use P-extension saturating shift instructions (PSSLAI, SSLAI, SRARI, PSSHA, PSSHAR variants) without saving/restoring or clearing the vxsat CSR before returning to S/U mode via MRET/SRET, leaking M-mode internal computation state to lower privilege levels
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: P-extension saturating shift instruction followed by MRET/SRET without intervening vxsat save/restore or clear
security_spec.summary: Saturating shift instructions set vxsat as a side effect; if M-mode OpenSBI uses them and returns to S/U mode without clearing vxsat, lower privilege modes can observe whether saturation occurred during M-mode execution, leaking information about M-mode internal data values
